notes: This minor release adds one pack and stays compatible with Bifrost 0.15.3 and later. It is built by the released, checksum-pinned bifrost-semantic-pack 0.15.3 (public commit f7e104a77b4f869f342dd73af0cc622c4a1a0584), the same producer as packs 0.15.0. The release index stays schema 4 and the bundle's semantic-model read schemas are unchanged. Added: the reviewed, authored bifrost.jdk-object-input-stream-summaries 0.1.0, which gives the ObjectInputStream(InputStream) constructor an allocation of its result (#408). The other 71 packs keep their IDs, versions and manifests. Why the producer stays on 0.15.3: on released Bifrost 0.15.4, a 0.15.4-produced bundle loaded through BIFROST_OPEN_SEMANTIC_PACK_BUNDLE panics during Java analysis when a JDK 21.0.8 is detected ("generated production digest"), so that producer is withheld until an engine release fixes it. Qualification: all 282 open policy fixtures were run on released Bifrost 0.15.4 with packs 0.15.0 and with this bundle, and 281 are identical. Known limitation: java-objectinputstream-read-without-filter goes from 7 findings to 0, still inconclusive, when a workspace also carries its own copy of bifrost.jdk-object-input-stream-summaries in .bifrost/semantic-models; remove the copy, and all 7 return. Source-only models, including the Flask, Werkzeug and Django request packs, are not in this native release. This release does not qualify every pack or imply complete analysis.
